caption: The drawing depicts a natural outdoor scene with multiple figures and elements set within an octagonal frame bordered in black and gold, with “MARY BOWERS” inscribed at the top and “LOOK BEYOND THE GRAVE” at the bottom. Central to the composition is a gray tomb or monument upon which an older woman in a brown dress sits with her head resting on her hand. In front of the tomb, a woman in a white dress adorned with a pink floral crown holds a young child’s hand; the child wears a white outfit and brown shoes. Ivy and a floral garland decorate the tomb. The background contains several tall willow and evergreen trees painted in shades of green, brown, and blue, with foliage extending across the upper half of the drawing. The foreground shows a grassy area with a pond colored blue and green; a white swan is floating on the water. Decorative yellow-gold floral motifs occupy the four corners of the black border. The sky is colored light blue, with clouds faintly visible above the treetops.
title: Memorial Picture
